catalog.label: Backorder value
catalog.definition: Value of material demand that could not be served from stock.

catalog.label: Consumption value
catalog.definition: Value of material issued to consumption in the month.

catalog.label: Critical spare availability
catalog.definition: Share of critical spares available when needed.

catalog.label: Days on hand
catalog.definition: Inventory value expressed as days of average consumption.

catalog.label: Delayed purchase orders
catalog.definition: Number of purchase orders delivered or open past their due date.

catalog.label: Duplicate SKU opportunity
catalog.definition: Inventory value that could be released by consolidating duplicate SKUs.

catalog.label: Excess inventory value
catalog.definition: Value of stock above the maximum stock level.

catalog.label: Gross inventory value
catalog.definition: Total value of stock on hand before any adjustment.

catalog.label: Inventory turnover
catalog.definition: Consumption value divided by average inventory value.

catalog.label: Non-moving inventory value
catalog.definition: Value of stock with no consumption in the non-moving window.

catalog.label: Obsolete inventory value
catalog.definition: Value of stock classified as obsolete.

catalog.label: Open PO quantity
catalog.definition: Quantity on purchase orders not yet received.

catalog.label: Open PO value
catalog.definition: Value of purchase orders not yet received.

catalog.label: Open PR count
catalog.definition: Number of purchase requisitions not yet converted or closed.

catalog.label: Open PR quantity
catalog.definition: Quantity on purchase requisitions not yet converted or closed.

catalog.label: Potential inventory reduction
catalog.definition: Inventory value that could be released against the target.

catalog.label: Potential inventory reduction %
catalog.definition: Potential reduction as a share of gross inventory value.

catalog.label: PO count
catalog.definition: Number of purchase orders raised in the month.

catalog.label: PO value
catalog.definition: Value of purchase orders raised in the month.

catalog.label: PR count
catalog.definition: Number of purchase requisitions raised in the month.

catalog.label: Slow-moving inventory value
catalog.definition: Value of stock classified as slow moving.

catalog.label: Stockout materials
catalog.definition: Number of materials with zero available stock.

catalog.label: Target inventory reduction %
catalog.definition: Inventory reduction target as a share of gross inventory value.

catalog.label: Understock materials
catalog.definition: Number of materials below their reorder point.

catalog.label: Working capital opportunity
catalog.definition: Working capital that could be released by the identified actions.
